title: The Ritual of Lost Souls
description: Watches a 21×21×21 area around the Master Ritual Stone for the moment of any non-player creature's death and drops a charged Raw Spiritus item at the death position. The richer the kill (Wither, Ender Dragon, Warden), the more Spiritus per drop. EV cost scales with the number of deaths processed each tick.
отслеживает смерти существ в радиусе 21×21×21, роняет Raw Spiritus на месте гибели. Чем сильнее моб - тем больше Spiritus
